response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior individual contributor with ~15 years of hands-on engineering across web, backend, and low-latency systems, plus some exposure to AI-agent tooling (MCP generators) and fintech-adjacent work at RIDE Capital. However, the role is an executive CTO position, and the resume shows no evidence of the hard requirements: no engineering management or team-scaling experience (10→30+), no senior technical leadership layer development, no production multi-agent AI systems, no board-level communication, and no experience governing outsourced delivery partners or building regulated AI/credit-risk infrastructure. The gap between a Staff/Senior IC profile and a venture-backed scale-up CTO mandate is too large to bridge in this hiring context.
strengths: Deep, broad hands-on engineering across 15+ years and many stacks
Low-latency distributed/microservices experience (millions of req/s at Sociomantic)
Some agentic-AI tooling exposure (MCP frameworks) and fintech-adjacent work at RIDE Capital
concerns: No people-management or engineering org-scaling track record
No production multi-agent AI systems in regulated/high-stakes settings
No fintech infrastructure depth (credit risk, liquidity, compliance) or executive/board experience
